city_name: Salvador & Baía de Todos os Santos, Brazil

boarding_points.name: Terminal São Joaquim (ferry-boat)
boarding_points.notes: Mainland terminal of the São Joaquim–Bom Despacho ferry-boat system; hourly departures 05:00–23:30, vehicles + foot passengers; 987-pax vessels in fleet; queue tracked live via the operator's 'filômetro'.

boarding_points.name: Terminal Marítimo de Bom Despacho (Itaparica)
boarding_points.notes: Island terminal of the ferry-boat crossing; gateway for road connections onward to the Baixo Sul / Morro de São Paulo via BA-001.

boarding_points.name: Terminal Turístico Náutico da Bahia (Comércio)
boarding_points.notes: Salvador's city-centre passenger pier: lanchas to Mar Grande every 30 min, catamarans to Morro de São Paulo (3+ daily), schooner day tours to Ilha dos Frades and Itaparica. R$2.00 terminal-use fee (TUTE) on boarding.

boarding_points.name: Terminal Marítimo de Mar Grande (Vera Cruz)
boarding_points.operator: Lancha cooperative service regulated by AGERBA (crossing association); terminal side managed with Socicam network
boarding_points.notes: Island end of the Salvador–Mar Grande lancha rápida crossing, ~30-min headways from early morning to evening; the bay's busiest foot-passenger lancha corridor.

boarding_points.name: Terminal Hidroviário de Morro de São Paulo (Cairu)
boarding_points.linked_locale: Morro de São Paulo, Ilha de Tinharé (Cairu)
boarding_points.notes: Car-free resort island pier; direct catamarans to/from Salvador Terminal Náutico (2h30 today, ~1h30 of it in open Atlantic swell). Whale-watching season Jul–Nov strengthens shoulder demand.

boarding_points.name: Velha Boipeba pier (Ilha de Boipeba)
boarding_points.notes: Landing for the quieter island south of Morro de São Paulo; today reached by 4x4-plus-boat combos or lancha transfers around Tinharé.

boarding_points.name: Bahia Marina
boarding_points.notes: Salvador's flagship full-service marina beside the city centre; natural premium-charter base and charging-pedestal anchor for the bay network.

boarding_points.name: Yacht Clube da Bahia
boarding_points.linked_locale: Salvador (Barra end of the bay entrance)
boarding_points.notes: Historic yacht club near the Barra lighthouse at the bay mouth; premium leisure spur and second charter node.

boarding_points.name: Marina Itaparica (Itaparica town)
boarding_points.linked_locale: Itaparica town (north tip of Itaparica island)
boarding_points.notes: Marina at the historic north tip of Itaparica island; schooner itineraries call nearby; marina-to-marina premium pairing with Bahia Marina.

boarding_points.name: Marina Aratu (Baía de Aratu)
boarding_points.operator: Marina Aratu (private; adjacent Aratu Iate Clube at -12.812316,-38.460791)
boarding_points.notes: Sheltered inner-bay marina cluster serving the Aratu industrial belt; corporate-commute and refit node for the northern bay.
boarding_points.source: OSM way 88539669 (Marina Aratu) / OSM way 103301593 (Aratu Iate Clube)

boarding_points.name: Píer de Ponta de Nossa Senhora de Guadalupe (Ilha dos Frades)
boarding_points.operator: Community/municipal landing; visitor tax R$34.90 collected on arrival
boarding_points.notes: Arrival pier for all Ilha dos Frades boat tours, at the Blue Flag Ponta de Nossa Senhora de Guadalupe beach. Coordinates from the OSM ferry terminal + pier pair at the island's south tip (node 11255095143 / way 462109070); pier name per tourism operators.

boarding_points.name: Terminal Marítimo São Tomé de Paripe
boarding_points.linked_locale: Salvador (São Tomé de Paripe, Subúrbio Ferroviário)
boarding_points.operator: Public landing; local lancha crossing to Ilha de Maré
boarding_points.notes: Suburban Salvador pier serving the short public crossing to Ilha de Maré, an inhabited island with no bridge or road access.
boarding_points.source: OSM way 181202711 (Terminal Marítimo São Tomé de Paripe)

boarding_points.name: Ilha de Maré landing (Paripe crossing)
boarding_points.notes: Island landing paired with the São Tomé de Paripe terminal (OSM pier way 181202710, mapped as the counterpart of the Paripe pier way 181202711). The pier itself is unnamed in OSM; identity inferred from the mapped crossing pair — confirm exact landing name (Itamoabo vs Praia Grande) at survey.
